blocks_element.text: Customers say this wireless bra provides exceptional support and a natural lift that rivals traditional underwire styles while remaining comfortable for extended wear. Users frequently mention the soft, premium fabric and the crossover design that is both functional and attractive, making it a versatile staple for any wardrobe. Some users mention the band feels snug on first couple of wears and side panels may sit higher under the arm depending on your body shape.
